affected_predicate.description: All posts tagged #pets are absent from the account's bookmarks.

competing_trace_defects.description: At step 12, the agent selected the menu item labeled “Bookmark” while intending to remove the post; at step 13 the same post's menu instead offers “Remove bookmark,” visibly showing it was bookmarked.

chains.rationale: The reused claim is reflected in step 13's erroneous removal-count framing, but its action opens the remaining post's menu. The menu then shows “Remove bookmark,” and step 14 selects that option, visibly correcting the prior bookmark-toggle error. The final static view does not independently establish the complete bookmark state for every #pets post.

summary: The reused false removal framing accompanies a menu-opening action that is followed by visible correction of the re-added bookmark; complete final predicate status is not independently observable.
